label: Harmonics of a square wave
subgoals: Identify the harmonic index as the frequency over the fundamental
Return zero for an even harmonic of a symmetric square wave
Compute an odd harmonic amplitude as two V over n pi

label: The knee frequency
subgoals: Take the rise time of the edge
Divide one half by the rise time to get the knee frequency
Set the model's required bandwidth from the knee frequency

label: The trapezoidal spectral envelope
subgoals: Compute the first corner from the pulse width
Compute the second corner from the rise time
Apply 20 dB and 40 dB per decade slopes beyond each corner
